steps.en: Create a client with your LLM key, naming a cheap index model and your best chat model
steps.zh: 带着 LLM key 建客户端，索引模型用便宜的，问答模型用最好的

steps.en: Builds a table-of-contents tree from the document's layout; a basic model only summarizes and refines
steps.zh: 在本地按文档版式建目录树，便宜模型只做摘要与精修

steps.en: Ask questions against the indexed document
steps.code: client.chat("What was the 2023 operating margin?", doc_id=doc_id)

steps.en: The chat model descends the right branch, returning an answer traceable to pages and sections
steps.zh: 问答模型沿对的分支下钻，返回可溯源到页和节的答案

value.en: Relevance-by-reasoning retrieval on one document, with no vector database, no chunk tuning, and citations you can audit
value.zh: 在单篇文档上“靠推理找相关”，不搭向量库、不调切块，引用可审计
